subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A pipe dream
solution:
The correct answer is " An illusionary plan".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In the given options, " An illusionary plan" is the most appropriate meaning of the idiom.
 
• We use the idiom- " A pipe dream" to mean - " An illusionary or Unattainable plan".
 
 
• Example: *Your meeting with the famous singer of the country sounds like a pipe dream__.*
 
 
 
• ​Thus, the correct answer is - "An illusionary plan".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__Let us understand more idioms related to the pipe.

__
 
• Pipe Down: It means to Calm down or stop talking about something.
 
• Example: *The teacher asked the children to pipe down__ otherwise she will not teach them.*
 
• Pipe Up: To say something after being silent.
 
• Example: *The child __piped up __- "Yes sir!" from behind.*
 
• Pipe one's eye: To weep or roll down tears.
 
• Example: *My mother could not resist __pipe her eyes__ when she met after five long years.*
 
• Take the gas pipe: To kill someone.
 
• Example: *She was so depressed her life that she tried to __take the gas pipe__ but thankfully her friends helped her a lot.*
